# TAD-RV LTS Release (Upcoming)

**:warning: Are you seeing the message ":( Oh no! Your PC is not supported by TAD-RV anymore!"?**

Starting with **v26.3.08.130**, TAD-RV requires modern PC hardware. Specifically, the latest versions require Windows 10 (or later), a contemporary dual-core or quad-core processor, and QuickSync support for the efficient Screen Recording and Remotevision functionality.

If you are trying to install or update TAD-RV on an older computer (e.g., Windows 7/8/8.1, single-core CPUs, or older processors such as Intel 3rd Gen Ivy Bridge), you will receive the incompatible hardware warning.

## We are working on an LTS Release!

Don't worry! We understand that school hardware is often reused and maintained for a very long time.

We are currently working on a **Long-Term Support (LTS)** release specifically designed for older hardware. The LTS version will:
- Support Windows 8.1 and possibly Windows 7
- Have lower RAM and CPU footprint
- Fall back to basic software encoding instead of hardware-accelerated QuickSync for screen sharing
- Omit overly experimental features in favor of stability

Please check back here or watch the [Releases](https://github.com/amiho-dev/TAD-RV/releases) page for updates on the LTS branch.
